description: Skills as loadable prompts: menu of one-line descriptions in context, full body loaded via tool when requested.

steps.description: Skill system: directory scanning, menu generation, and load_skill tool.
Setup: imports and SKILLS dict built from glob pattern for */SKILL.md.
Description extraction: reads the description: line from front matter.
Agent: Agent with make_model and instructions.
Skill menu: @agent.instructions decorator generates one-line menu of available skills.
Load_skill tool: tool_plain decorator, reads full SKILL.md body after front matter.
Execution: run_sync with study plan request, show first and last context to see menu vs loaded skill.

title: Pydantic AI: Skill System
